title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno
description:
Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno


***Quem somos

A DEXIAN, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como DEXIAN, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


***O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A DEXIAN está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


***Nosso cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, que atua oferecendo serviços de logística e que se especializa na movimentação de contêineres e cargas em todo o Brasil.


***O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

- Atuar no ciclo de gestão de vulnerabilidades, incluindo análise de superfície de ataque, testes de invasão, avaliação de vulnerabilidades em código e imagens de containers, provendo direcionamento estratégico para mitigação dos riscos identificados;

- Cooperar com as áreas de Infraestrutura, Cloud, Desenvolvimento de Sistemas e Sustentação na implementação de controles técnicos e procedimentais necessários para remediação de vulnerabilidades, promovendo integração entre equipes e sinergia dos processos;

- Acompanhar projetos de Pentest, conduzidos pelo Centro de Defesa Cibernética (CDC) ou por consultorias externas, desde o planejamento e execução até o acompanhamento do plano de correção, garantindo a efetividade das ações de remediação;

- Apoiar o time de Desenvolvimento de Software na integração de soluções de AppSec (Orca, Veracode e outras) ao pipeline de desenvolvimento, facilitando a identificação e resolução contínua de vulnerabilidades em ambientes;

- Monitorar e analisar relatórios periódicos de segurança cibernética e implementar planos de ação para melhoria contínua da postura de segurança, reportando indicadores ao Business Information Security Officer (BISO);

- Pesquisar, selecionar e coordenar provas de conceito (POC) de soluções de cibersegurança alinhadas com as necessidades estratégicas da empresa;

- Apoiar, quando necessário, auditorias internas e externas sobre maturidade em segurança da informação, fornecendo evidências, respostas técnicas qualificadas e conduzindo o plano de ação corretivo pós-auditoria.


***O que você precisa ter

- Formação superior preferencialmente na área de TI;

- Experiência prévia nas frentes de gestão de vulnerabilidades;

- Vivência com ferramentas e práticas de AppSec (Veracode, Snyk, Orca Security, CI/CD pipelines).;

- Conhecimento em frameworks e normas de segurança (OWASP, NIST, CIS, ISO 27001, MITRE ATT&CK);

- Capacidade de analisar e comunicar resultados técnicos para áreas técnicas, gestão e executivos;

- Visão analítica, foco em resultados e senso de urgência para atuação diante de riscos e incidentes;

- Habilidade para comunicação efetiva e trabalho colaborativo com equipes técnicas e de negócio;

- Proatividade para propor melhorias e evolução dos processos e ferramentas;

- Mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo, com forte autonomia e capacidade autodidata para atualização constante frente às mudanças e inovações tecnológicas.


***Você vai trabalhar

• Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime Híbrido – Atuação presencial 2x por semana em no bairro do Cajuru, em Curitiba – PR.

title: Brand Marketing Senior Manager – Latin America
description:
Job Purpose

The Brand Marketing Senior Manager will lead the development and execution of the marketing and communication strategy for Clarios’ portfolio of products and services brands in Latin America, including LTH, Heliar, and MAC. This role is responsible for growing brand equity, driving customer and consumer adoption of products and services, generating demand for direct-to-consumer (D2C) business models, and maximizing marketing spend ROI.

The role will ensure consistent brand messaging and positioning across B2B, B2C, and internal audiences, while also collaborating closely with Global Marketing to align regional brand strategies with the overarching Clarios corporate brand.

Key Responsibilities

1. Brand Strategy & Equity Growth

  • Lead brand positioning and value proposition development for LTH, Heliar, MAC, and other regional brands.
  • Ensure consistent brand identity and messaging across all touchpoints and audiences.
  • Monitor brand health and perception, and implement strategies to strengthen equity.
  • Ensure brand protection and compliance by working closely with the Legal department on trademark usage, brand guidelines, and intellectual property matters.

2. Marketing & Communication Strategy

  • Design and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital, trade, and traditional channels.
  • Align messaging across B2B, B2C, and internal stakeholders to ensure clarity and consistency.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing to translate product features into compelling customer benefits.

3. Customer & Consumer Adoption

  • Develop strategies to drive awareness, engagement, and adoption of products and services.
  • Support commercial teams with marketing tools and campaigns tailored to customer segments.
  • Lead internal communication efforts to build brand and product understanding across the organization.



4. Demand Generation & D2C Growth

  • Build and execute demand generation strategies to support D2C business models.
  • Leverage digital marketing, CRM, and performance analytics to drive traffic and conversions.
  • Optimize marketing funnels and campaign performance for ROI.

5. Global Collaboration

  • Act as the regional marketing liaison with Global Marketing and Corporate Communication to ensure alignment between local brand strategies and the Clarios corporate brand.
  • Contribute to global brand initiatives and ensure regional execution reflects global standards.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Brand Equity Metrics (Awareness, Consideration, Preference)
  • Customer/Consumer Adoption Rates
  • D2C Demand Generation KPIs (Traffic, Leads, Conversions)
  • Marketing ROI and Spend Efficiency
  • Internal Brand Engagement Scores

Qualifications

Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or related field.

• MBA or equivalent postgraduate degree preferred.

Experience:

• 8+ years in marketing leadership roles, preferably in B2B2C or industrial sectors.

• Proven experience managing strong consumer brands in Latin America.

• Experience in integrated marketing, digital strategy, and brand management.

• Familiarity with global/regional brand alignment processes.

Skills:

• Strategic thinking with strong execution capabilities

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills

• Data-driven mindset with strong analytical skills

• Fluent in Spanish, English and Portuguese

• Proficiency in marketing tools and platforms (CRM, digital analytics, automation)

Travel Requirements

• Up to 25% regional travel

title: Sr. Specialist – Football Category (Marketing)
description:
Purpose & Overall Relevance for the Organization:


At adidas, we have a clear purpose: “Through sport, we have the power to change lives.” This guiding principle shapes how we operate as a company, how we collaborate with our partners, how we create our products, and how we connect with our consumers. Our values represent essential behaviours and mindsets, reflecting the “You Got This” attitude we strive to see in every team member.

This same purpose and mindset are at the heart of Concept to Consumer (CTC) role that enable consumer-focused category execution by coordinating product availability, impactful seasonal campaigns activations and driving in-season trading strategies. This role ensures cross-functional alignment and operational excellence across channels to deliver impactful consumer experiences and business results.



Key Responsibilities:


  • Generate and consolidate market and financial insights (incl. sell-out data), to inform category strategy, transforming it into actionable insights for category and commercial teams.
  • Own the input of country range selection into planning systems, enabling a seamless end-to-end sell-in process.
  • Monitor and report category performance in-season, identifying risks and opportunities to optimize sell-through.
  • Coordinate in-season trading strategies across channels, ensuring agility in response to market dynamics.
  • Participate in category activation planning in collaboration with Brand Comms, Omni, and channels teams.
  • Manage campaign calendars and launch timelines, communicating changes and coordinating execution across functions.
  • Ensure product availability by aligning with supply chain, demand planning, and account teams.
  • Support discount and inventory strategies, including slow mover management and license expiration considerations.
  • Facilitate cross-functional meetings and communications, acting as the central connector between CTC, channels, and brand teams.
  • Manage Key Franchises: Oversee the product lifecycle through sell-out monitoring and inventory coverage control. Propose corrective actions when necessary, aligned with the category’s strategic plan. Key decisions include sell-out simulations to assess the need for Speed activation (product replenishment) or production cuts
  • Forecasting and Buying Suggestions: Generate forecasts and purchase recommendations based on category strategy. Monitor adherence and take action when needed (e.g., additional buys or order cancellations).
  • End-to-End Product Creation Coordination: Manage the product creation process for local clubs. Act as the link between Sports Marketing, Clubs, and the Global Creation Team — from initial briefing and sample approval to margin analysis and feasibility checks.
  • Pre-Sell Engagement: Actively participate in pre-sell meetings with key accounts to share strategy and provide guidance.
  • BU Weekly Coordination: Lead weekly alignment meetings with all relevant functions within the Business Unit.
  • Brand Campaign Support: Provide strategic input and feedback to ensure category campaigns reflect business priorities.


Key Relationships:


  • CTC Category Leads
  • Marketing Operations
  • Brand Comms, SPOMA and Omnichannel Teams
  • Demand Planning
  • Supply Chain team
  • Channels


Knowledge Skills and Abilities :


  • Strong analytical and reporting capabilities (e.g., Excel, Power BI)
  • Deep understanding of consumer and market dynamics
  • Excellent coordination and communication skills
  • Proficiency in campaign planning and product lifecycle management
  • Ability to manage complexity and drive cross-functional alignment


Requisite Education and Experience / Minimum Qualifications:


  • University degree or equivalent education
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in category management, marketing, or commercial operations

title: Domain Architect End User
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Domain Architect End User , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid / remote , in the city of Belo Horizonte - MG.


In this role you will:

The Domain Architect – End User Computing has the responsibility of designing, governing, and evolving the architectures that support the end-user experience in Brasil and Canada's operations. This includes devices, desktops, laptops, mobile, virtualization, collaboration, remote support, and digital workspace solutions. The goal is to provide modern, secure, efficient environments aligned with user needs, ensuring high availability, ease of use, and integration with corporate platforms.

This professional will work collaboratively to implement innovative solutions that promote productivity, security, automation and mobility, respecting international governance and security standards, and with a clear vision of user-centered digital transformation.


Main Responsibilities

  • Define and maintain end-to-end architectures for End User Computing (EUC) environments, encompassing physical, virtual, mobile, virtual desktops (VDI), BYOD and collaboration devices.
  • Establish standards and frameworks for device provisioning, management, and security, including access policies, identity control (IAM), encryption, and threat protection.
  • Lead modernization and digital transformation initiatives for smart workspaces, with a focus on automation, self-service, cloud integration, collaboration (MS Teams, Zoom), and mobile applications.
  • Evaluate and implement virtualization, mobile device management (MDM), endpoint security (EDR), zero-trust, monitoring, and remote support technologies.
  • Proactively work to solve performance, scalability, and availability challenges, ensuring support for remote and hybrid work.
  • Collaborate with IT, security, business, and operations to align demands and promote the best end-user experience.
  • Promote effective governance, complying with global regulations (LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA) and internal policies.
  • Produce complete documentation, guides, contingency plans, training, and best practices for support and operation teams.
  • Participate in forums, workshops, and innovation projects to keep the technological environment in line with global trends.

Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Higher education in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or similar areas.
  • Solid experience (minimum 8 years) in architecture, management and innovation of the End User Computing environment in global companies or highly complex sectors.
  • Advanced knowledge in EUC platforms and tools: Microsoft 365, Windows Desktop, macOS, VDI (Citrix, VMware Horizon), MDM (Intune, MobileIron), collaboration tools (Teams, Zoom).
  • Expertise in device security, zero trust, identity and access management (Azure AD, Okta), encryption, endpoint protection, automation, and monitoring.
  • Experience with hybrid and remote work environments, advanced technical support and strategies to maximize productivity and security.
  • Fluent English for global technical communication, advanced Portuguese for Brazil-Canada alignment.


Soft Skills

  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with technical teams, end users and executives.
  • Analytical skills, solution orientation and user-centered innovation.
  • Leadership, influence, and ability to work in multicultural and collaborative environments.
  • Proactivity, organization and focus on delivering continuous value.

Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Certifications in Project Management (PMP, Prince2) or Change Management (PROSCI Certified Change Practitioner).
  • Specific experience in the mining sector, digital transformation, or major global initiatives.
  • Knowledge of digital tools for Change Management and collaborative communication (MS Teams, SharePoint, Yammer, etc.).

Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Solid and scalable architecture of the End User Computing environment for Brazil and Canada.
  • Modernization and automation of workspaces, with substantial improvement of the end-user experience.
  • Ensuring security, compliance, and availability in distributed and hybrid environments.
  • Leadership in the dissemination of best practices, training and qualification of regional teams.
  • Support for digital transformation and user-focused innovation in environments of high operational complexity.


Additional Comments:

Domain Architect – End User Computing is essential to ensure that operations in Brazil and Canada have a unified, secure and efficient digital experience, supporting the current challenges of mobility, security and productivity in hybrid environments.

title: Domain Architect Data Analytics and AI
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Domain Architect Data Analytics and AI , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid / remote , in the city of Belo Horizonte - MG.


In this role you will:

The Domain Architect – Data Analytics and AI is responsible for defining and guiding the architecture of Brasil and Canada's data and artificial intelligence ecosystems, enabling the extraction of strategic insights from large volumes of operational and corporate data. He will work strategically in the design and governance of advanced analytics, machine learning, deep learning, predictive models, cognitive automation, and scalable data platforms.

This professional will work closely with data engineering, data science, operations, IT, and business teams, ensuring that data platforms are architected to support efficiency, security, scalability, regulatory compliance, and continuous innovation in mining and energy.


Main Responsibilities

  • Define and evolve data and AI architectures, including data lake design, data warehouses, machine learning platforms, data pipelines, orchestration, and governance.
  • Design solutions for data ingestion, storage, processing, analysis and visualization in highly complex environments, integrating multiple data sources (IoT, industrial sensing, ERP, cloud).
  • Lead initiatives to implement advanced analytical models, cognitive automation, explainable artificial intelligence, and machine/deep learning platforms.
  • Ensure compliance with data protection regulations (LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA) and data security, including in the cloud, by applying best governance practices.
  • Work together with multidisciplinary teams on digital transformation projects, providing architectural and technical expertise for strategic use of data.
  • Produce detailed documentation, architectural plans, policies, and technical standards that promote scalability, reuse, and efficient governance.
  • Evaluate emerging tools and technologies to enhance analytics ecosystems, including AI frameworks, AI Ops, cloud platforms, and big data.
  • Foster data culture, technical capacity building and best practices through training, workshops and mentoring.
  • Participate in technical forums and communities to keep the architecture aligned with global trends and business needs.


Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Higher education in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Data Science or related areas.
  • Minimum 8 years of solid experience in data architecture, analytics and artificial intelligence in multinational companies or industrial/mining sector.
  • Expertise em frameworks e ferramentas de dados e IA: Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, Python, R, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, GCP AI Platform.
  • Deep knowledge in design and administration of data lakes, data warehouses, streams, NoSQL databases, Lambda/Kappa architectures.
  • Experience in creating and managing data pipelines, data governance, data quality, automation and CI/CD for AI models.
  • Solid knowledge in data security, privacy, regulatory compliance (LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA).
  • Fluent English for technical and strategic communication; advanced Portuguese for Brazil-Canada integration.


Soft Skills

  • Strategic technical leadership skills, fluency in communication with different audiences.
  • Analytical and strategic vision to connect data to business decisions and innovation.
  • Proactivity, adaptability, and collaboration in multicultural and multidisciplinary environments.
  • Results-oriented approach and continuous improvement.


Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Certificações avançadas: Cloudera/Databricks Certified, Azure Data Scientist, AWS Big Data Specialty, Google Professional Data Engineer, TOGAF.
  • Experience in digital mining projects, industrial IoT, digital twins, predictive analytics and AI Ops.
  • Participation in global technical programs and communities, international publications or presentations.


Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Robust architecture of data and AI ecosystems for Brazil and Canada, supporting predictive analytics, operational intelligence and innovation.
  • Execution of strategic digital transformation projects driven by data, machine learning and AI.
  • Dissemination of data governance, policies, training and technical enablement.
  • Audit, compliance, and data security support.
  • Direct influence on data-driven decision-making, sustainability and global operational excellence.


Additional Comments:

This professional will play a key role in data-driven transformation, enabling operational excellence and innovation in Brazil and Canada, working in a dynamic, integrated environment of high technological and regulatory complexity.

title: Especialista em Gestão de Incidentes
description:
Estamos procurando um Especialista em Gestão de Incidentes para se juntar à nossa equipe de Cyber Security. O candidato selecionado será responsável por atuar na investigação e resposta a incidentes de segurança, gerir serviços de análises forenses e continuidade de negócios. Se inscreva e faça parte da maior processadora de meios de pagamento independente da América Latina!


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Liderar e executar a investigação de incidentes de segurança cibernética de alta complexidade, desde a detecção inicial até a contenção, erradicação e recuperação.
  • Realizar análises aprofundadas de logs, tráfego de rede, endpoints e outras fontes de dados para identificar a causa raiz dos incidentes e determinar o escopo do impacto.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos de resposta a incidentes, garantindo a coordenação eficaz com equipes internas e externas.
  • Documentar detalhadamente os incidentes, as ações tomadas e as lições aprendidas para aprimorar os processos futuros.
  • Participar ativamente na definição e refinamento do playbook de resposta a incidentes.
  • Atuar como ponto focal para solicitações de análise forense digital, tanto em cenários de incidentes quanto em investigações internas ou requisições legais.
  • Definir e aprimorar os processos e ferramentas para a aquisição, preservação, análise e apresentação de evidências digitais.
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo das investigações forenses, garantindo a integridade e a cadeia de custódia das evidências.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico especializado e consultoria em questões relacionadas à análise forense.
  • Colaborar na criação, revisão e teste de planos de continuidade de negócios e recuperação de desastres, garantindo a resiliência dos sistemas e dados críticos.
  • Identificar pontos de falha potenciais e desenvolver estratégias de mitigação para minimizar o impacto de interrupções.
  • Participar da simulação e exercícios de BCDR para validar a eficácia dos planos e identificar áreas de melhoria.
  • Garantir a integração dos aspectos de segurança da informação nos planos de continuidade de negócios.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outras equipes de TI e de negócios para garantir a segurança de dados.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências e validação de controles relacionados a gestão de incidentes de segurança.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Curso superior completo em Tecnologia.
  • Experiência na área de Segurança da Informação, com foco em investigação e resposta a incidentes.
  • Conhecimento profundo de metodologias e frameworks de resposta a incidentes (e.g., NIST, SANS).
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de SIEM (Security Information and Event Management), EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response), NIDS/NIPS (Network Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems).
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em análise forense digital, incluindo aquisição, análise de memória, disco e rede.
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell) para automação de tarefas de segurança e análise.
  • Entendimento de arquiteturas de rede, sistemas operacionais (Windows, Linux) e tecnologias de nuvem.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks de segurança (e.g., ISO 27001, LGPD/GDPR, NIST CSF).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e lidar com situações de crise de forma eficaz.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de apresentar informações técnicas de forma clara e concisa para diferentes públicos.
  • Inglês avançado.

Oportunidade de fazer parte de uma cultura inclusiva na Deloitte Brasil

description:

ELSA is a leading innovator in English communication services, dedicated to transforming how people improve their English skills. Our flagship B2B solutions — ELSA Enterprise and ELSA Schools — leverage advanced AI to deliver personalized, real-time feedback on pronunciation, fluency, and communication effectiveness. ELSA empowers enterprises to enhance workplace communication and helps students build confidence and fluency through engaging, bite-sized learning experiences.


Our vision is to become the global leader in real-time, conversational English learning — empowering over 1.5 billion language learners worldwide to speak with confidence, be understood, and share their stories. Join our talented team using the power of AI and proprietary speech recognition technology to make a real impact.


Backed by top-tier VCs like Google’s Gradient Ventures , Monk’s Hill Ventures, and SOSV, we have offices in the U.S., Vietnam, Portugal, Indonesia, Brazil, and Japan.


Recognition includes:

As a Business Development member of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to foster your career path with the growth of a startup from Silicon Valley. Our startup culture will bring you a chance and challenge, you will never have a boring day with ELSA.

title: Analista de Comunicação e MKT SR
description:
Somos o Grupo SADA! Um grupo referência em transporte e logística, além de atuação em diversos segmentos de negócios movidos por milhares de pessoas dispostas a darem o seu melhor, todos os dias. Somos serviços, informação, indústria, concessionárias, energia limpa, esporte e responsabilidade social movimentando a vida das pessoas há mais de 45 anos, e é isso que nos faz ir mais longe.

Somos plurais por natureza, um grupo diverso em negócios e pessoas. Acreditamos que as diferenças somam e movimentam, e é por isso que o Grupo SADA quer conhecer você. Todas as nossas vagas são extensivas as Pessoas com Deficiência e profissionais reabilitados do INSS. Quem sabe alguma oportunidade combina com você.


Resumo da Posição:


O Grupo SADA , referência nacional em transporte, logística, mobilidade e investimentos diversificados, está em busca de um(a) Analista de Comunicação e Marketing Sênior para fortalecer o posicionamento institucional e contribuir com estratégias que ampliem a presença e a reputação da marca.


Se você tem perfil criativo, estratégico e colaborativo, e quer atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, inovador e com propósito, essa oportunidade é para você!


Oportunidade: Analista de Comunicação e Marketing Sênior

Local: Betim/MG

Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Presencial


Principais responsabilidades:


✅ Desenvolver e executar estratégias de comunicação que fortaleçam o posicionamento institucional e reforcem a identidade da marca Grupo SADA.

✅ Planejar, conduzir e monitorar campanhas corporativas e institucionais , utilizando os recursos disponíveis para atingir os objetivos definidos.

✅ Produzir e revisar conteúdos institucionais e corporativos para canais internos e externos (intranet, redes sociais, site, comunicados, releases, newsletters, entre outros).

✅ Acompanhar e gerir entregas de fornecedores e agências de comunicação , garantindo qualidade e alinhamento com a estratégia da empresa.

✅ Apoiar e conduzir eventos corporativos e institucionais – presenciais e online – desde o planejamento até a execução (infraestrutura, cronograma, briefing e plano de comunicação).

✅ Compreender as demandas e necessidades dos clientes internos , propondo soluções de comunicação adequadas a cada público e contexto.

✅ Liderar projetos e iniciativas estratégicas dentro de sua área de responsabilidade, assegurando entregas com excelência e inovação.

✅ Estabelecer e manter relacionamento com stakeholders , tanto internos quanto externos, fortalecendo a imagem institucional do Grupo.

✅ Colaborar com áreas correlatas (Marketing, ESG, RH, Comunicação Interna, etc.) para garantir coerência e consistência nas mensagens corporativas.


REQUISITOS NECESSÁRIOS:


✅ Formação superior completa em Comunicação Social, Jornalismo, Publicidade e Propaganda, Relações Públicas, Marketing ou áreas afins.

✅ Experiência consolidada em Comunicação Corporativa e/ou Marketing Institucional, preferencialmente em empresas de grande porte.

✅ Vivência com planejamento, execução e gestão de campanhas de comunicação e eventos corporativos.

✅ Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa, estratégica e orientada a resultados.

✅ Organização, proatividade e visão de negócio para propor soluções criativas e viáveis.

✅ Conhecimento intermediário ou avançado em ferramentas de design e comunicação digital (Canva, PowerPoint, plataformas de e-mail marketing e mídias sociais).


REQUISITOS DIFERENCIAIS:

✅ Pós-graduação ou MBA em Comunicação Corporativa, Branding, Marketing Estratégico ou Gestão de Crises.

✅ Vivência em comunicação interna e endomarketing, com foco em engajamento de colaboradores.

✅ Experiência em gestão de fornecedores e agências de comunicação.

✅ Conhecimento em métricas de comunicação e marketing digital (Google Analytics, Power BI, Meta Business Suite, etc.).

✅ Atuação prévia em projetos de responsabilidade social, ESG ou cultura organizacional.


Por que fazer parte do Grupo SADA?


No Grupo SADA , acreditamos que a comunicação é um elo essencial entre pessoas, propósito e resultados. Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente desafiador, colaborativo e em constante transformação, onde suas ideias e seu talento podem gerar impacto real.


Venha fazer parte dessa história!

Candidate-se e contribua para fortalecer a marca e a cultura do Grupo SADA.


NOSSA HISTÓRIA

Para contar a história do nosso grupo empresarial precisamos voltar ao Brasil dos anos 70, quando um jovem visionário desembarcava da Europa trazendo objetivos bem audaciosos. Ali, iniciava a trajetória da SADA, com a implantação de uma pequena transportadora na região metropolitana de Belo Horizonte.


Fundada em 4 de agosto de 1976, na cidade de Contagem, em Minas Gerais, a SADA Transportes e Armazéns S/A é criada, a partir da necessidade de atender as demandas de armazenagem e distribuição automobilística no país.


Sete anos depois, em 1983, a empresa é transferida para Betim em um terreno de cerca de 31 mil metros quadrados, 23 vezes menor que a área ocupada pela empresa atualmente.

“Ainda muito jovem, cheguei aqui vindo da Itália com a tarefa de montar a SADA no Brasil junto com a chegada da Fiat”, conta Vittorio Medioli, fundador presidente do Grupo SADA.


Assim como seu precursor, a origem do nome SADA também é italiana.

title: Business Technology Application Subject Matter Expert
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Business Technology Application Subject Matter Expert to join our team.


Our Client is one of the United States’ largest insurers, providing a wide range of insurance and financial services products with gross written premiums well over US$25 Billion (P&C). They proudly serve more than 10 million U.S. households with more than 19 million individual policies across all 50 states through the efforts of over 48,000 exclusive and independent agents and nearly 18,500 employees. Finally, our Client is part of one the largest Insurance Groups in the world.


About the team

The Tech Enablement team drives innovation across marketing automation, data engineering, and internal application development. We architect and maintain scalable solutions leveraging platforms like Segment and Braze to enable real-time personalization, campaign orchestration, and seamless data integration. Our team bridges business strategy and technical execution, designing robust data pipelines, optimizing customer journeys, and introducing agentic AI and embedded platforms to enhance operational efficiency. We collaborate cross-functionally to deliver high-impact solutions that support direct distribution, campaign performance, and enterprise transformation.


About the role

This role provides technical expertise in the design, functionality, and optimization of business applications. The ideal candidate will have experience supporting marketing-focused teams and be comfortable maintaining and enhancing existing marketing platforms. While marketing is a key area of support, the role is not limited to that function and may span other business domains. Candidates should have a strong technical foundation—including scripting or programming experience—and the ability to apply emerging AI patterns to improve business processes and system performance.


We count on you for:

  • Providing expertise in the design and functionality of business applications.

  • Reviewing and validating the detailed technical design for business applications provided by the supplier to ensure alignment with business requirements.

  • Performing impact analysis of application changes across various components, holding an end-to-end view of the system.
  • Estimating Rough Order of Magnitude for the level of effort/cost of new application functionality.
  • Specifying / recommending integration and parallel testing criteria.
  • Supporting the implementation activities, troubleshooting system environmental issues, as required.

  • 3 to 5 years of related experience
  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Technology, Computer Science or a related field (Marketing is also acceptable).

Technical & Business Skills

  • Scripting Languages (Python, C#, Etc.)

  • Office 365, including Copilot

Benefits

This position comes with a competitive compensation and benefits package.

  • A competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
  • Comprehensive benefits package.

  • You will also enjoy a dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group.

title: Senior Media Manager
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world , Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!


Know more: Keeta Website


Location : 100% on site - Vila Olimpia, SP


Please submit your resume in English.


About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior Media Manager to lead media negotiations and strategy for offline, online channels and events management. You will be responsible for the end-to-end media and events process - from negotiation and planning to execution and post-campaign analysis - ensuring maximum ROI and brand impact for our food delivery technology platform.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Lead negotiations with media partners and agencies across digital and traditional channels, securing optimal terms and value for the brand.
  • Develop and execute integrated media strategies, balancing online (social, display, programmatic, influencers, etc.), offline (TV, radio, OOH, print) and events investments.
  • Using data analytics, determine the best media outlet mix and optimize our campaigns accordingly. If necessary, build models to understand and improve performance.
  • Oversee media planning, buying, and implementation, ensuring alignment with business objectives and campaign goals.
  • Monitor media performance, analyze campaign results, and present actionable insights to stakeholders for continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (social strategy, brand, business intelligence) and external partners to optimize media mix and drive business growth.
  • Manage media budgets, ensuring efficient allocation and cost control throughout negotiation and execution phases.
  • Stay updated on media trends, emerging platforms, and industry benchmarks to inform strategy and innovation.


Job Requirements:

  • Advanced English proficiency for interaction with global teams.
  • Strong negotiation skills, especially in media plan negotiations and vendor management.
  • Solid experience in media planning, buying, and performance analysis.
  • Proven track record in negotiating with media vendors and agencies.
  • Analytical mindset with ability to interpret data and translate results into strategic recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience in technology, e-commerce, or food delivery industries is a plus.

title: Loyalty and Subscription Strategies Manager
description:
Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Location: 100% on site - Vila Olimpia, SP

Please upload an English version of your resume.


About the Position

We are looking for a strategic and creative professional to lead our Gamification & Subscription Strategies efforts. This role focuses on building innovative mechanisms such as missions, streaks, and loyalty programs that drive user engagement, as well as developing subscription-based models that strengthen recurrence and create long-term value. You will design, test, and scale programs that make our platform fun, sticky, and habit-forming, positioning us to compete head-to-head with established loyalty schemes in the market.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement gamification strategies (progress bars, streaks, missions, rewards) that increase frequency and stickiness across user segments.
  • Develop and refine subscription models and loyalty programs that maximize user retention and LTV, while differentiating from competitor offerings.
  • Collaborate with CRM, Growth, and Product teams to integrate gamification mechanics into the user journey and app experience.
  • Conduct A/B testing and experimentation to evaluate the impact of gamified features and subscription perks on user behavior.
  • Monitor and analyze engagement metrics, progression funnel, and churn patterns to optimize program design and efficiency.
  • Partner with Data and Finance teams to build business cases for gamification and subscription initiatives, measuring ROI and long-term sustainability.
  • Explore partnerships with restaurants, brands, and third parties to enrich the subscription and gamification ecosystem.
  • Stay ahead of market trends and competitor strategies, ensuring our programs are locally relevant, innovative, and scalable.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in business, economics, engineering, or related fields.
  • Robust experience in user operations, loyalty, CRM, or product growth strategy in digital platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in SQL, Python, or other tools to extract insights and validate impact.
  • Demonstrated experience in designing and scaling gamification or subscription programs.
  • Familiarity with user segmentation, behavioral psychology, and habit-forming product design.
  • Background in e-commerce, O2O, food delivery, or subscription-based businesses preferred.
  • Strong project management and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Creative, data-driven, and results-oriented, with the ability to balance user delight with business impact.


We hope to see you soon ;)


#Keeta #EatBetter #Live Better

title: Pessoa Especialista de Governança de Identidades - IAM / IGA
description:
Sobre a vaga

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.



Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.



O DESAFIO

Estamos procurando uma pessoa para fazer parte do nosso time Segurança da Informação aqui na Dimensa. É uma vaga hibrida, 3X por semana no nosso escritório da Av Braz Leme em São Paulo.

Você será responsável por garantir a segurança, conformidade e eficiência na gestão de identidades e acessos através da implementação, operação e evolução contínua de soluções IAM/IGA.


O QUE PRECISA

  • Administrar e evoluir as soluções de IAM/IGA com foco em Horacius E-Trust, Google Identity e Keycloak.
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida de identidades (provisionamento, alteração e desprovisionamento).
  • Definir e aplicar políticas de acesso baseadas em perfil, função e risco.
  • Garantir conformidade com normas de segurança e auditoria de acessos.
  • Realizar integrações entre sistemas internos e plataformas de autenticação/autorização.
  • Monitorar e responder a incidentes relacionados à identidade digital.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas com evidências e relatórios de acessos.
  • Conduzir revisões periódicas de acessos e certificações de identidade.
  • Documentar processos, fluxos e regras de negócio relacionados à governança de identidades.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para temas de IAM/IGA na empresa.
  • Ensino Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


DIFERENCIAL

  • Administração e integração de Horacius E-Trust
  • Gestão de identidades com Google Identity e Keycloak
  • Protocolos de autenticação: SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect
  • Conceitos de RBAC, ABAC e políticas de acesso
  • Ferramentas de auditoria e logging de acesso
  • Integrações via API/REST para automação de provisionamento
  • Segurança da informação e gestão de riscos
  • Conhecimento em frameworks como NIST, ISO 27001, LGPD
  • Certificações em soluções específicas (Horacius E-Trust, Google Cloud Identity, Keycloak ou aplicações correlatas)
  • Certificações em segurança da informação (CompTIA Security+, ISO 27001, ou similares)
  • Certificações de algum provedor de núvem pública: AWS, GCP ou Azure
  • Obrigatório: Curso ou experiência comprovada em implantação de algum IAM/IGA



O QUE OFERECEMOS:


️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Analista de Performance em Marketplaces

  • Resultado com propósito: Esforço sem resultado não é virtude — é ineficiência. Valorizamos resultados concretos que impactam diretamente em nossos objetivos.

Na ZAWA, oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza a independência, com liberdade para autogestão do tempo e alta perspectiva de crescimento. Operamos com processos enxutos e eficientes, em uma estrutura organizacional compacta (equipe de 5 a 10 pessoas). title: Gerente de Marketing
description:
About the Brand We're a bold beauty brand redefining service, fun and results. With our unique DNA and iconic products, we create experiences that go beyond makeup — connecting people, services, and storytelling in every touchpoint.


Role Summary The Marketing Manager 360° sits at the intersection of all cross-functional teams driving the brand and product marketing strategy forward in Brazil. This person blends strategic thinking and creative execution, ensuring the brand remains innovative, disruptive, and locally relevant. You'll bring global campaigns to life in a uniquely Brazilian way, with a consumer-first mindset, a sharp eye for detail, and a passion for brand storytelling and results.


Key Responsibilities


Integrated / 360° Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and execute the full 360° marketing strategy for Brazil, aligned with LATAM and global direction.
  • Bring to life the brand DNA through impactful and locally relevant campaigns, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (creative, digital, retail, PR, influencer, trade, and education) to deliver cohesive brand experiences.
  • Adapt global campaigns and craft localized initiatives based on strategic insights and consumer behavior.
  • Define KPIs and monitor performance to ensure ROI and continuous optimization.
  • Manage marketing budget efficiently and align investments with business priorities.


Brand Activations, Events & Partnerships

  • Ideate and lead brand activations, pop-ups, and in-store experiences that amplify engagement and conversion.
  • Collaborate with influencer and PR teams to develop creative and culturally relevant events, trips, and product send-outs that generate strong EMV and social buzz.
  • Build and manage brand partnerships that expand audience reach while maintaining aspirational image and consistency. This includes experience with negotiating partnership agreements.
  • Oversee the brand's visual merchandising expression across retail doors, ensuring high-quality, on-brand execution.
  • Partner with the Retail & Education teams to boost service awareness and service sales across stores.
  • Coordinate GWP programs, launch activations, and local communication campaigns with a consumer-centric mindset.
  • The ability to analyze ROI for each activation will be key to ensure the spend had a positive impact on retail sales.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Serve as the local bridge between global brand strategy and field execution.
  • Ensure flawless implementation across channels (in-store, online, influencer, social).
  • Lead project timelines, agency briefings, creative reviews, and post-campaign analysis.
  • Partner with Operations, Supply, and Trade Marketing to secure on-time delivery and smooth rollout.
  • Ensure effective communication and collaboration with sales and finance teams to align objectives and maximize results.
  • Report regularly to management on marketing KPIs, results, and insights.


Who You Are

  • 5–10 years of experience in Marketing or Brand Management within beauty, FMCG, or lifestyle industries.
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian retail landscape and consumer behavior.
  • Creative and strategic thinker, with a proven ability to innovate within Global brand guidelines and create data-driven digital campaigns that boost brand awareness and sales.
  • Expertise in marketing strategy combined with strong financial acumen, including proven ability to prepare and manage budgets, analyze marketing spend, forecast sales, and develop data-driven strategies aligned with commercial objectives and measurable impact.
  • Excellent project management and multitasking abilities.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across departments.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and deadline-driven.
  • MANDATORY Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a plus).
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (especially PowerPoint), Google Workspace, and ideally Asana or Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Passion for beauty, trends, and building emotional consumer connections.
  • Experience working with global brands and adapting marketing strategies to local markets.


Success Metrics

  • Growth in brand awareness and preference above market trend.
  • Increase in service sales and store traffic.
  • Strong ROI on campaigns and activations.
  • Excellent cross-functional alignment and execution quality.
  • Elevated brand perception and consumer engagement.


Why Join Us We're not just selling beauty — we're creating moments of joy, confidence, and connection. If you're a marketer who blends creativity, curiosity, and commercial drive, and you want to make an impact in a dynamic, growing brand — this is your next challenge.

title: Profissional QA Lead
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Domínio em automação de testes com Cypress e Robot Framework;
  • Experiência com Git, pipelines de CI/CD e integração de testes em fluxos de entrega;
  • Habilidade de comunicação para lidar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Experiência em liderança de times ou atuação como referência técnica.
  • Vivência com BDD e testes orientados a comportamento;
  • Conhecimentos em performance testing e/ou testes de segurança;
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Jira, TestRail, Jenkins, Docker.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: SAP Specialist - HCM - SuccessFactors
description:
Job Overview

The SAP/SuccessFactors Specialist will be part of ADM’s Service Delivery Organization , responsible for ensuring high system availability and reliable operations across all ADM systems.

In this role, you will analyze and resolve user tickets, collaborate with internal teams and third-party providers, and ensure timely resolution within defined Operational and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) .

You will also partner with architects, developers, and testers to design and deliver small enhancements aligned with the global template, following approval from the Solution Delivery Organization.


Key Responsibilities


  • Provide deep functional and technical expertise in the respective process area, with solid understanding of key integration points across modules and technical components.
  • Take full ownership of support tickets within your process area; collaborate with integration, development, and external support teams to ensure timely resolution within SLA limits.
  • Maintain integrity of the global and regional templates designed by Solution Delivery teams while resolving incidents.
  • Conduct thorough testing — including regression testing — before final user validation and release.
  • Adhere to ADM IT processes and Service Management standards, ensuring accurate and up-to-date ticket documentation.
  • Design and configure minor system enhancements, following ADM’s configuration and naming standards, and document functional design specifications.
  • Support audit and compliance requests by providing accurate and timely technical inputs.
  • Ensure all activities comply with regulatory, security, and ADM policy requirements .
  • Partner with global process and system experts to identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities in business processes.



Job Requirements


  • Experience in one or more SAP/SuccessFactors modules ; experience with S/4HANA strongly preferred.
  • Functional knowledge in HR processes such as Employee/Personnel Administration, Payroll, Organization Management, Talent, Compensation, Benefits, Time & Attendance, and Learning Management ; experience in HCM or SuccessFactors required.
  • Experience with integration between SAP HCM/SuccessFactors and S/4HANA ; integration with external payroll or learning systems is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of SAP/SuccessFactors localizations supporting global HR deployments.
  • Proven experience in a support analyst role within a medium or large organization.
  • Experience providing 24x7 global support in multicultural, distributed teams.
  • Previous experience leading a team of support analysts is highly preferred.
  • Exposure to full lifecycle SAP implementations and agile methodologies is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with ability to convey complex information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic, and global environment , managing changing priorities with flexibility and professionalism.
  • Strong collaboration, conflict resolution, and problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness to work occasional weekends, holidays, or different shifts as required to meet SLA commitments.
  • Availability to travel occasionally (domestic and international).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, or a related field.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory; Spanish is desirable

title: Consultor SAP SD
description:
Resumo da vaga

Estamos em busca de um Consultor SAP SD experiente, especializado em localização brasileira , para atuar na configuração, implementação e conformidade dentro do SAP ECC .

O candidato ideal deverá ter sólida experiência em requisitos fiscais e regulatórios locais, incluindo NF-e e processos de Nota Fiscal , além de experiência na integração do módulo SAP SD com outros módulos principais.

Esta função requer fluência em português e inglês , habilidades práticas de configuração e capacidade de adaptação a ambientes fiscais e empresariais em constante evolução.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Configuração e implementação:
  • Projetar, configurar e implementar processos de SAP SD no SAP ECC , adaptando o modelo global para atender às exigências legais, fiscais e regulatórias brasileiras.
  • Expertise em localização:
  • Gerenciar a localização específica do Brasil, incluindo emissão eletrônica (NF-e) , documentos fiscais (nota fiscal), novas mudanças da reforma tributária e determinação de CFOP .
  • Tributação e conformidade:
  • Garantir a conformidade com as leis fiscais brasileiras sobre vendas, incluindo ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS , além de configurar os cálculos e regras de contabilização correspondentes.
  • Integração:
  • Trabalhar nas integrações entre os módulos SAP SD e MM/FI , especialmente em processos logísticos e lançamentos fiscais.
  • Colaboração técnica:
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores ABAP para desenvolver e testar especificações funcionais de melhorias personalizadas (RICEFW ).
  • Gestão de projetos e mudanças:
  • Gerenciar múltiplas tarefas, apoiar as fases de implantação de projetos e se adaptar a novas leis e regulamentações tributárias.
  • Suporte:
  • Fornecer suporte durante o cutover e hypercare após o go-live.



Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência em SAP: 8 a 10 anos de experiência em SAP SD , com foco em localização brasileira .
  • Conhecimento de localização: Profundo conhecimento da localização SAP para o Brasil, incluindo transformação eletrônica e requisitos de e-documents .
  • Conhecimento de sistemas: Experiência em projetos de implementação e implantação SAP ECC é um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento funcional: Familiaridade com outros módulos, como MM e FI , é vantajosa.
  • Idioma: Fluência em português e inglês é essencial.
  • Comunicação: Fortes habilidades analíticas, de resolução de problemas e excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.

title: Network & Security Operations Analyst
description:
Responsibilities：

1. Design, implement, and manage network segmentation between IT and OT domains, ensuring compliance with zero-trust and defense-in-depth principles.

2. Configure and maintain high-availability firewalls, redundant paths, and routing failover policies across data centers and remote sites.

3. Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) for major network or or security incidents and produce corrective-action plans.

4. Develop and maintain network addressing plans, DHCP scopes, NAT rules, and routing policies to guarantee scalability and consistency.

5. Oversee vulnerability remediation activities and validate the effectiveness of penetration-test mitigation actions.

6. Integrate security device logs into SIEM, coordinate with SOC for event correlation and incident escalation.

7. Perform periodic configuration audits and enforce change-management best practices (RFC approval, rollback validation, and documentation).

8. Define and maintain technical standards for VLAN naming, access control, and monitoring configurations.

9. Mentor junior and mid-level analysts, conducting knowledge-transfer sessions and technical training workshops.

10. Coordinate network readiness activities for plant expansions, data-center upgrades, and cloud integrations.

11. Prepare and present monthly KPI and performance dashboards, highlighting trends in latency, availability, and incident rates.

12. Represent the Network Operations function during internal and external audits, ensuring evidence of compliance with ISO 27001 controls.

13. Participate in policy reviews and contribute to global infrastructure standardization with BYD Global IT.

14. Conduct disaster-recovery testing and validate failover mechanisms to ensure business continuity.


Required Quality：

1. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Networks, Information Security, or Telecommunications.

2. Minimum of 6 years of experience in enterprise network design, administration, or security operations.

3. Advanced knowledge of routing, switching, VPN, and firewall management across multi-vendor environments.

4. Proven experience with segmentation projects separating OT and IT environments.

5. Hands-on expertise with firewalls, IDS/IPS, NAC, and SIEM platforms (Fortinet, Cisco, or Palo Alto).

6. Deep understanding of network availability, latency, and performance metrics (MTTD/MTTR).

7. Proficiency in network troubleshooting using packet-capture and analysis tools (Wireshark, NetFlow).

8. Strong ability to manage incident response, root-cause analysis, and postmortem reporting.

9. Familiarity with ISO 27001, NIST, and LGPD security controls applied to network operations.

10. Fluent English for documentation, reporting, and technical meetings; Mandarin is an advantage.

11. Excellent leadership and mentoring skills to guide junior and mid-level analysts.

12. Certifications preferred: Cisco CCNP, Fortinet NSE6, or equivalent professional-level credentials.

13. Solid understanding of EHS and NR compliance, ensuring safe interventions in critical environments.

14. Strong analytical thinking and ability to standardize processes across multiple sites.

15. Availability for travel and participation in corporate audits and cross-site projects.

title: SAP Functional SD Consultant
description:
ITC Infotech is looking for a SAP SD Consultant to join our team in Brazil.

Work Location: Onsite at Project location.


About Us:

ITC Infotech is a leading global technology services and solutions provider, led by Business and Technology Consulting. ITC Infotech provides business-friendly solutions to help clients succeed and be future-ready, by seamlessly bringing together digital expertise, strong industry speciﬁc alliances and the unique ability to leverage deep domain expertise from ITC Group businesses. We provide technology solutions and services to enterprises across industries such as Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Travel and Hospitality, through a combination of traditional and newer business models, as a long-term sustainable partner.


Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP SD Consultant specializing in Brazilian localization to support configuration, implementation, and compliance within SAP ECC. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in local tax and regulatory requirements, including NF-e and Nota Fiscal processes, and experience integrating SAP SD with other core modules. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English, hands-on configuration skills, and the ability to adapt to evolving tax and business environments.

Key responsibilities

  • Configuration and implementation:

Design, configure, and implement SAP SD processes in SAP ECC, adapting the global template to meet Brazilian statutory, tax, and regulatory needs.

  • Localization expertise:

Handle Brazil-specific localization, including e-invoicing (NF-e), fiscal documents (nota fiscal), new tax reform changes and CFOP determination.

  • Tax and compliance:

Ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws on sales, including ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, and configure related tax calculations and posting rules.

  • Integration:

Work on integrations between SAP SD and other modules like MM and FI, especially for logistics and tax postings.

  • Technical collaboration:

Partner with ABAP developers to develop and test functional specifications for custom enhancements (RICEFW).

  • Project and change management:

Manage multiple work assignments, support project rollout phases, and adapt to new tax laws and regulations.

  • Support:

Provide cutover and hypercare support after go-live.


Required skills and experience

  • SAP experience: 8-10 years of experience in SAP SD, with a focus on Brazilian localization.
  • Localization knowledge: Deep knowledge of Brazilian SAP localization, including e-transformation and e-document requirements.
  • System knowledge: Experience in SAP ECC implementation and deployment projects is a plus.
  • Functional knowledge: Familiarity with other modules like MM and FI is beneficial.
  • Language proficiency: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is often required.
  • Communication: Strong analytical, problem-solving, verbal, and written communication skills.

Se você está sempre buscando novas maneiras de crescer e enfrentar desafios, se trabalha no desenvolvimento de pessoas capazes de conquistar suas metas profissionais além das metas da organização, a SIG tem um lugar para você. Para entregar o melhor aos nossos clientes, nossos colegas constroem uma forte relação com eles e trabalham para apresentar as soluções de que eles precisam. Por fim, estamos buscando pessoas que sejam capazes de construir parcerias e trabalhar de maneira colaborativa rumo ao alcance dos objetivos comuns. Você é alguém que aplica conhecimento de negócios e mercado para promover os objetivos da organização? Você é alguém capaz de criar novas e melhores maneiras de a organização ter sucesso? Se a resposta é “sim”, venha e junte-se a nós.


Nosso Compromisso


A SIG é o lugar onde você pode construir algo incrível. Nós oferecemos uma remuneração competitiva e a oportunidade de trabalho remoto em regime parcial. Caso se junte a nós, você fará parte de uma organização internacional de sucesso global: a líder do segmento em sustentabilidade, tecnologia e inovação. Nós nos enxergamos como uma pista de decolagem de uma carreira; um lugar de rápido desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, com trabalho, experiências e oportunidades reais de se adquirir novas habilidades. Você fará parte de uma equipe altamente motivada e dinâmica, e terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal, além de capacitação e orientação profissional junto de colegas de equipe experientes. Se você mostrar que é capaz e tem vontade de aprender, nós lhe daremos todo o apoio.


Sobre a SIG


A SIG é líder em sistemas de embalagens e soluções. Trabalhamos em parceria com nossos clientes para levar alimentos aos consumidores de todo o mundo de forma segura, sustentável e acessível. Somos o único fornecedor de um sistema de embalagens que trabalha com embalagens cartonadas e dos tipos pouches e bag-in-box. Nossa tecnologia versátil e nossas habilidades em inovação de produto nos permitem entregar o melhor para nossos clientes, nossos consumidores e para o mundo. A sustentabilidade nos guia, a tecnologia nos capacita, mas é a paixão e a motivação de nossa gente que realmente nos inspira a entregar o melhor.

Fundada em 1853, a SIG possui sua sede em Neuhausen, na Suíça, e está listada na Bolsa de Valores SIX Swiss Exchange.

title: Lead Data Platform Architect
description:
Lead Data Platform Architect


Mars is a family-owned business with more than $50 billion in global sales. We produce some of the world’s best-loved brands: M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, MILKY WAY®, DOVE®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, WHISKAS®, EXTRA®, ORBIT®, 5™, SKITTLES®, BEN’S ORIGINAL®, and COCOAVIA®. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCA™ and Pet Partners™. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.


The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:


As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:


TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR


DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns


DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models


Knowledge and Experience


ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.
  • Strong background in data modelling, architecture frameworks, and modern data integration methods.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure) and tools (Databricks, SQL, ADF etc) as well as analytics solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align across business and technology functions.
  • Experience building and evolving data & platform architectures that scale and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Passion for coaching and enabling others with a collaborative leadership approach.
  • Knowledgeable in Data Source systems (eg. SAP) and Data Lake technology
  • Stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Fluent in writing and speaking English


DESIRED:

  • Previous experience in CPG industry would be ideal
  • Experience at operating in a complex global matrix organisation
  • Experience at collaborating with cross-functional partners
  • High drive for results and an ability to work with minimum input


What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.


Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

title: Analista de Sistemas e Negócio Especialista
description:

Desde 2011, a Aperam South America integra o Grupo Aperam, segundo maior da Europa, composto de outras cinco plantas industriais na França e na Bélgica, cuja capacidade alcança 2,5 milhões de toneladas de placas de aço por ano.

Com um modelo sustentável único em seu segmento, a Aperam South America é carbono neutro nos escopos 1 e 2 desde 2020, além de ser uma das poucas siderúrgicas brasileiras certificadas com o selo ResponsibleSteel.


Por que escolher a Aperam?


Somos um lugar incrível para trabalhar! No segmento de Siderurgia e Mineração, conquistamos o 2º lugar no Prêmio “Lugares Incríveis para Trabalhar” , posição que mantemos há cinco anos. Esse reconhecimento reflete o nível de satisfação de nossas pessoas colaboradoras e nossa excelência em gestão de pessoas, clima organizacional e liderança.


Acreditamos que a diversidade fortalece nossa equipe e que a inclusão é essencial para um ambiente mais inovador e colaborativo. Buscamos pessoas que queiram crescer em um time que valoriza diferentes perspectivas e experiências.

O que buscamos?

  • Gerenciar e priorizar demandas de aplicações de negócios, garantindo alinhamento à estratégia de TI e governança global

O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição:

  • Experiência Sólida em Gestão de Serviços de TI (ITSM) e Gestão de Demandas.
  • Conhecimento e experiência em SAP .

  • Experiência com modelos de suporte terceirizados e equipes globais.
  • Inglês fluente (Obrigatório) ; Francês é um diferencial.
  • Sólida experiência em Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Equipes de alta performance.


Competências Chave:


  • Forte entendimento de processos de gerenciamento de incidentes, requisições e mudanças.
  • Habilidade para gerenciar desempenho de fornecedores (SLAs, KPIs).
  • Capacidade de atuar como mediador eficaz entre equipes de Negócio e de TI.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, gestão de stakeholders e foco no cliente.
  • Abordagem estruturada, mentalidade analítica e foco em resolução de problemas.
  • Habilidade para gerenciar projetos complexos e implementar PMO.
  • Autonomia, agilidade e capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão.


Benefícios que oferecemos:

Nosso processo de seleção


Nosso processo de seleção, de forma geral, é constituído das seguintes etapas: inscrição e análise dos perfis com avaliação de currículos, entrevistas e dinâmicas (se necessário) com time de gente e gestão e líderes, avaliações comportamentais e ou técnicas (se necessário) e exames admissionais.
